history.summary: Large 912-unit D18 Pasir Ris leasehold, 2BR at $1.39M / $1,382psf on a generous 1,012sqft layout. Best all-round profile in the batch: clean 5.95% resale-only URA over 260 transactions (no new-launch bias), frontier unit, top arena score (816). Mature 2017 build, well-maintained, deep liquidity.
history.rating_rationale: Honest 5.95%/yr URA backed by 260 transactions (high confidence, no bias adjustment needed), asking $1,382psf is below the $1,526 URA median, and the 912-unit size gives genuine exit liquidity. Sub-$1.4M entry sits in an accessible price band for HDB upgraders. Pasir Ris benefits from CRL (Pasir Ris terminus ~2030) and the Pasir Ris Mall/integrated transport hub. Only modest road noise on expressway-facing stacks.

Pasir Ris Mall + bus interchange integrated hub completed

history.summary: Genuinely cheap OCR 1BR in Pasir Ris with a confirmed dated MRT catalyst; the algo's cheapness checks out against real recent transactions.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,403 psf sits below D'Nest's verified last-12-month average of ~$1,496 psf (range $1,252-$1,614, with a 484 sqft unit hitting $1,672 psf in Mar 2025), so the -10.1% age-adj and -12.8% cohort premium are real, not a scrape error, even though the 1BR cohort is thin (5 txns). Sub-$800k quantum, OCR location (realized fwd OCR ~+4.0% is the best region under v3.4), 912-unit project with deep liquidity (260 appreciation txns) and a confirmed Cross Island Line Pasir Ris interchange landing ~2030 give a concrete forward catalyst. Trailing 5.95% CAGR is treated as story only.
red_flags: 1BR psf cohort is thin (only 5 txns) so the precise -12.8% cohort discount is noisy
99-yr leasehold from 2010 means ~83 yrs left; OCR far-east location has structurally lower prestige/rent ceiling
1BR exit demand in a 912-unit project is mostly investor/single-tenant, not owner-occupier
catalysts: Cross Island Line Pasir Ris interchange targeted ~2030 (Phase 1) directly lifts connectivity
Asking psf below verified recent project average leaves immediate margin
Low absolute quantum (<$800k) widens the buyer pool and supports liquidity
